ios.desc:
Panda – Meditation Timer
Panda is a simple, distraction-free meditation timer designed to help you slow down, breathe, and build a consistent mindfulness habit - one session at a time.

Why Panda Meditation Timer?

Meditation doesn’t need to be complicated. Panda Meditation Timer focuses on simplicity and calm so you can stay present and focused during every session.Whether you’re new to meditation or already practicing regularly, Panda Meditation Timer gives you just the essentials: flexible timers, gentle sounds, and a clean interface that stays out of your way.

Features

• Custom Meditation Timer
Set your preferred meditation duration with ease - no unnecessary settings or clutter.

• Gentle Start & End Sounds
Choose calming sounds to begin and end your sessions without interruption.

• Minimal, Peaceful Design
A clean interface designed to reduce distractions and support mindfulness.

• Daily Practice Support
Use Panda as part of your daily routine to pause, reflect, and reset.

• On-Device & Private

Designed for Mindfulness 

Panda Meditation Timer is built for moments of stillness - whether you’re meditating in the morning, taking a mindful break during the day, or winding down at night. 
No pressure. No noise. Just time for yourself.All timer settings and sessions stay on your device. No accounts required.

• AUM 02 (528Hz) - https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/aum-02-528hz-22432/
• Bell FX - https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/bell-fx-410608/

Privacy First

Panda Meditation Timer respects your privacy. The core meditation timer works entirely on your device and does not require personal information.
 
Start Your Practice

Create space to breathe, focus, and reconnect - with Panda Meditation Timer

show_hn.title: Show HN: Panda – Minimalist Meditation Timer App

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I’m excited to introduce Panda Meditation Timer, a minimalist, distraction free timer designed to help you focus on your meditation practice.

After struggling with overly complicated meditation apps that added unnecessary features, I decided to create Panda, a simple tool that helps you set your meditation session with ease and stay present during your practice. It’s all about simplicity and mindfulness, without the clutter.

Features:

Simple & Intuitive Design: No overwhelming features, just what you need.

Customizable Timers: Set your own durations for meditation or select from presets.

Gentle Sounds: Bell and Mantra modes.

Cross-Platform: Available on both iOS and Android, so you can practice wherever you go.

Reminders: Daily reminders so you do not miss a session.

Panda is perfect for beginners and experienced who want a tool that helps them focus on their practice, not on setting up complex apps.

Links:

iOS (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/panda-meditation-timer/id6757805939

Android (Play Store):https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.chromiumone.panda

Landing Page:https://www.chromiumone.com/apps/en-US/meditation-timer-panda/

Quick preview: https://youtube.com/shorts/KnYKn9zIQhA?feature=share

Feel free to check it out and let me know what you think!  I’d love to hear your thoughts, feedback, or suggestions for future updates.
